notes.en: [[character:mitya]]'s weapon rankings can vary greatly depending on team composition. This notably affects weapons that provide [[stat:em]] and [[stat:er]].

note.en: If you have **[C1]** or use [[character:mitya]] in a team with three [[element:electro]] characters, this weapon performs worse than **[[weapon:blackmarrow-lantern]]**.
At **[R5]**, this weapon performs better than **[[weapon:reliquary-of-truth]]**.

If you use [[character:mitya]] in a team with three [[element:electro]] characters, this weapon performs similarly to **[[weapon:starcallers-watch]]**. This weapon's performance is slightly variable depending on how much teammates value its [[stat:em]] buff.
At **[R5]**, this weapon performs better than **[[weapon:sunny-morning-sleep-in]]**.

Assumes there are three [[element:cryo]] and [[element:electro]] characters in the team. At **[R5]**, this weapon performs better than **[[weapon:sunny-morning-sleep-in]]**. If you have four [[element:cryo]] and [[element:electro]] characters in the team, this weapon performs similarly to **[[weapon:dawning-frost]]** at the same refinement.
At **[R5]**, this weapon performs equal to **[[weapon:etherlight-spindlelute]]**.
At **[R5]**, this weapon performs better than **[[weapon:nightweavers-looking-glass]]**.
